    "Simplified project management across multiple projects",
    "Effective for tracking and collaborating on workflow charts",
    "Ability to link multiple documents to dashboards for comprehensive reporting"

  "cons": [
    "Experienced a learning curve when first adopting the platform",
    "Limited customization options for specific project needs",
    "Occasionally encountered issues with the copy/paste functionality"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This planning and project control engineer found Smartsheet to be a highly effective tool for managing and tracking multiple construction projects. While there was an initial learning curve, the platform ultimately simplified their project management tasks, enabled effective collaboration on workflow charts, and facilitated automated reporting processes. The ability to link various Smartsheet documents to a central dashboard was particularly beneficial for their role in a large construction company."
